main_text.p: cui liberum est non adire hæreditatem: quæ res ef-ficit,ut sit necesse legatariis, ne destituto testamento nihil consequantur, cum hærede in portione pacisci. §.quantitas.inst.eod.
main_text.head: QUIS EST VICESIMUS tertius Titulus? De fideicommissariis hæreditatibus, & ad Senatusconsultum Trebellianum. Von erbschafften auß trewem befelch zu ent-richten/und vom Rathsgebott Trebelliano.
main_text.p: SCiendum est omnia fideicommissa primis temporibus infirma fuisse: quia nemo invitus cogebatur præstare id, de quo rogatus erat. §. sciendum. inst. eod.

In primis sciendum est, opus esse, ut aliquis recto jure testamento hæres instituatur: ejusq; fidei com-mittatur, ut eam hæreditatem alij restituat: alioqui inutile est testamentum in quo nemo hæres institui-tur.§.in primis inst.eod.
main_text.head: QUIS EST VICESIMUS tertius Titulus? De singulis rebus per fideicommissum relictis. Von besondern und einzeln gütern/so durch vertrewlichen befehle nachgelassen sein.

page.notes: The first and second division headings are printed in italic and capitals with decorative initial letters (Q, S), which were read as the plain letters. The German subtitles are in black letter and were read with some uncertainty; the initial "V" of "Von" may be a printed "B". The vowel "u" spelled "v" in the German ("vnd", "vertrewlichen") was normalised to "u" per the rules. The word "Potest" at the foot right is the catchword; no signature is printed. The cross-reference "§. sciendum. inst. eod." and the other § references stay in the text. The fragment at the top is printed as continued from the previous page.
